{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite 1", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high intangible assets and low accruals tend to outperform due to their ability to invest in growth opportunities while maintaining financial discipline.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Accruals"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true},

"mechanism": "Companies with high R&D investment and low debt financing tend to outperform due to their ability to innovate and avoid financial distress.",
